keys.swarm.aura_war_drum_desc: A war drum beats in rhythm; every 4th beat is a big one, and monsters it hits take extra damage for a while.
keys.swarm.aura_war_drum_up: A faster beat and a bigger 4th beat.
keys.swarm.aura_war_drum_ten: Thunder Drum: lightning strikes on every big beat.
keys.swarm.aura_grudge_mark_desc: You hurl a heavy axe at whoever hit you last; it marks them (+25% damage taken per mark, up to 3). A marked monster that dies explodes.
keys.swarm.aura_grudge_mark_ten: Vendetta: axes fly at up to 5 marked monsters at once.
